claim: AIHW Hospitals at a glance Table 2 displays five ATS category presentation counts for 2024–25. Their sum is 9,091,132. The displayed total is 9,094,312, leaving an unexplained 3,180-event residual. The table does not explain that difference; this record does not assign the residual to unreported triage or any other category. The sum is a candidate denominator only for proportions conditional on the five displayed counts; it is not an established source-defined exhaustive cohort denominator. This is an unaccepted transcription candidate, not a schema-qualified primary-source claim.
